productionPromotion.reason: Evidence intake records are source observations only. They do not satisfy second-person verification or catalog-manager approval.

scanPolicy.downloadsRule: Downloads are scanned only for files named with an open capture-request ID such as GFM-CAP-001.
scanPolicy.intakeDirectoryRule: The dedicated research intake directory accepts supported media files for triage.
scanPolicy.ignoredDerivativeRule: Generated keyframes, contact sheets, derivative frames, and prior review crops are excluded from source intake.
